notes: Large upright multiphoton assembly with vertical black AX R MP scanner above the optical head, separate incident IR relay and NDD epi detector block.
Single large CFI75 water-dipping objective on motorized focus carriage, consistent with supported single-holder configuration; no invented six-objective turret.
Motorized objective focus up 13/down 2 mm and XY stage ±34/±27 mm have manufacturer evidence; installation rails are static.
Every model has documented physical scale anchors; total installed envelope is inferred for the photographed configuration, not an official dimensional specification.
No exact, openly licensed complete mesh found in recorded searches; original procedural meshes, no manufacturer image textures.
Digital stage/focus motion only; no optical performance, hardware control or protocol adapter is validated.
coverage_blockers: Facility #33 does not identify its exact AX-FNSP single-stand / AX-FNGP gate-stand subtype. The AX R MP optical system is confirmed and scaled, but the detailed host stand configuration needs independent confirmation before counting facility coverage.
